body: BLOCK exact 3c3b617ab0b218749de69a695d0d45f13ec4431e over base e1422d1332d67dc7f5b8ce0a7ff93bd68295e776. The original fixes are substantively present: inner attribution slack is absorbed, the production RepetitionRule.Ignore path attributes RepetitionPolicy, and BelowMembership now records a numeric threshold. Exact focused candidate suites ResolutionSuite 19/19 and PlacementProducerSuite 2/2 pass. One temporary adversarial JVM court fails: PlacementResolution.of accepts every invalid new membership threshold tested in ExclusionCause.BelowMembership -- NaN, +Infinity, -Infinity, -0.1, and 1.1 -- while publishing it as the exclusion cause. This violates the stable threshold invariant and allows the new attribution record to contain no valid threshold. Required successor: make the membership threshold finite and in [0,1] through a validated boundary (or reject invalid causes in PlacementResolution.of) and retain a court for all five values. No objection to the existing absorption/producer repairs.
